name: The One App
tagline: Application for managing a player's characters in the RPG The One Ring.
blurb: This application contains all the information of a character.
description:
This application contains all the information of a character. It allows the creation of new characters and the automatic management of many game features (e.g. shadow conversion, rest, levelling up, ...).

If you have any question, you can reach me on discord: https://discord.gg/ZFstbnfppZ
